context.description: The state audit fails on state held outside xstate

evidence.trustReason: Each of eight named harness constructs is planted alone into a copied source tree and the unchanged audit is run as a nested Bun test. The control copy passes; every plant fails and reports its file, identifier and expected rule. The same procedure catches Effect.sleep and Schedule in task-ui while outside-UI controls pass. The audit runs against the real tree with no unlisted, stale or unreasoned entry; blanking one written DISPLAY reason makes it fail by name.
